group PACS_Server_Exported_Functions

uint8_t pacs_pac_add(T_AUDIO_DIRECTION direction, const uint8_t *pac_data, uint8_t pac_data_len, bool notify)

Register PAC record. This API shall be called before pacs_init.

pasc_mgr.h

Parameters:

  • direction -- [in] Audio direction: T_AUDIO_DIRECTION.

  • pac_data -- [in] Pointer to the PAC data. This parameter shall not use local variables, and the audio lib only holds pointers internally.

  • pac_data_len -- [in] PAC data length. This parameter shall not use local variables.

  • notify -- [in] Whether notify is supported.

    • true Notify is supported.

    • false Notify is not supported.

Return values:

PAC_RECORD_INVALID_ID -- Register PAC record failed.

Returns:

PAC ID.

bool pacs_init(T_PACS_PARAMS *p_param)

Initialize PACS Service.

pasc_mgr.h

This API shall be called before gap_start_bt_stack.

Parameters:

p_param -- [in] Pointer to PACS Service parameters: T_PACS_PARAMS.

Return values:

  • true -- Initializing PACS Service is successful.

  • false -- Initializing PACS Service failed.

Returns:

The result of initializing PACS.

bool pacs_pac_update(uint8_t pac_id, const uint8_t *pac_data, uint8_t pac_data_len)

pasc_mgr.h

Return values:
